command: set -e; git fetch --prune --tags origin; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "e75af928954004fbe8f13c2cf36c7f581370d513"; test "$(git rev-parse origin/work/freeze-v2.0.10)" = "e75af928954004fbe8f13c2cf36c7f581370d513"; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "1cd0215548aea5203b064fcf2b24c4c628f1c30e"; test "$(git rev-parse refs/tags/v2.0.9)" = "90378921a79ed3ecb43013e322d27629bf15db64"; test "$(git rev-parse 'v2.0.9^{}')" = "b44899ba66b202ca05f48a8856a9871daee97832"; ! git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/tags/v2.0.10; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"; ADB="$SDK/platform-tools/adb"; test -x "$ADB"; DEVICES="$("$ADB" devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | sed '/^$/d')"; test "$DEVICES" = "RFCT70L7E8J"; MODEL="$("$ADB" -s RFCT70L7E8J shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')"; printf 'authorized_device=%s model=%s\n' "$DEVICES" "$MODEL"; test "$MODEL" = "SM-S906B" -o "$MODEL" = "SM_S906B"
